workflow_name: Android App Performance Root Diagnostic - Flow 2: Core Performance State Analysis

node_05_running_increase_issue.suggestion: Suggest app team checking running time increase from app side

node_12_frequency_check.operator: ## Analysis Rules: Focus on highest frequency: Compare the average percentage (in 3 cycles) of time spent at the highest available frequency (section by section between DUT & REF), Threshold detection: Flag issues when DUT runs significantly less at high frequency than REF (REF.percentage(average) - DUT.percentage(average) > threshold), Problem identification: Look for patterns where DUT has lower high-frequency usage in critical app sections ## Data Format: Check each cycle's frequency distribution for bindApplication, activityStart, activityResume, Choreographer. Compare DUT vs REF frequency percentages (in average of 3 cycles) for the same sections ```Focus on highest frequency ratios```

node_17_frequency_issue.problem: {section} running at lower CPU frequency DUT (section.average percentage in 3 cycle) & REF (section.average percentage in 3 cycle)
node_17_frequency_issue.suggestion: Suggest system team check frequency problem

node_14_query_running_version.query: Check new app version or fix

node_24_binder_issue.problem: Binder transactions increased DUT {DUT.binder.count} binder and REF {REF.binder.count} binder
node_24_binder_issue.suggestion: Suggest App team check bindertransaction increase

node_08_priority_check.operator: ## Analysis Rules: Focus on high priority (high value mean low priority): Compare the percentage of time spent at the highest available priority (cycle by cycle, section by section between DUT & REF), Threshold detection: Flag issues when DUT runs significantly less at high priority than REF (>threshold% difference), Problem identification: Look for patterns where DUT has lower high-priority usage in critical app sections ## Data Format: Check each cycle's priority distribution for bindApplication, activityStart, activityResume, Choreographer. Compare DUT vs REF priority percentages for the same sections ```Focus on highest priority ratios```

node_34_priority_issue.suggestion: Suggest system team check scheduling priority

node_38_beks_issue.suggestion: Suggest System team check BEKS config

node_39_start_kill_issue.problem: App start/kill count differs between DUT and REF
node_39_start_kill_issue.suggestion: Suggest App team check start/kill issue
